body:
After having one failed attempt at tripping on Brugmansia, I decided to try it one last time.
The first time I tried it, I ingested 25 seeds. I didn't really feel much of anything. So, this time I ate 35 fresh White angel trumpet Brugmansia seeds. After about an hour, I felt kind of dizzy, and nauseous.
So I smoked a bowl or two of weed. It immediately took effect.
I smoked a bowl or two of weed. It immediately took effect.
I had a very strong weed high, and I felt different than I have ever felt when smoking. It got hard for me to walk, and my body felt numb.
After about half an hour, the nausea came back, so I smoked another bowl. It was nearly impossible for me to stay awake. I didn't have any true hallucinations. I did have a few closed eye visuals, and auditory hallucinations, but nothing near what I was hoping for.
I'm hoping to order some seeds, and just grow the plant myself. This plant has really disappointed me.
